hooks.command: if [ -f .claude/plans/programme-run-followups.md ]; then echo '## Recent locked decisions (plan file)'; echo ''; grep -E '^\| (W?[0-9]+|RP[0-9]+|F[0-9]+|S[0-9]+|P[0-9]+|A[0-9]+|Sub[0-9]+|Set[0-9]+|Home[0-9]+|Pgm[0-9]+|Hist[0-9]+|Soc[0-9]+|Food[0-9]+|Run[0-9]+) \|' .claude/plans/programme-run-followups.md | tail -3 | awk -F'|' '{gsub(/^ +| +$/, "", $2); gsub(/^ +| +$/, "", $3); printf "- **%s** -- %s\n", $2, $3}'; echo ''; echo '_Full plan: .claude/plans/programme-run-followups.md_'; fi

input=$(cat); printf '%s' "$input" | grep -q '"stop_hook_active"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true' && exit 0; branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$branch" in main|master|HEAD) exit 0;; esac; if git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{upstream} >/dev/null 2>&1; then ahead=$(git rev-list --count @{upstream}..HEAD 2>/dev/null); elif git rev-parse --verify -q origin/main >/dev/null 2>&1; then ahead=$(git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD 2>/dev/null); else ahead=$(git rev-list --count HEAD 2>/dev/null); fi; [ "${ahead:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null || exit 0; head=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null); sentinel="$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null)/.claude-closeout-reminded"; if [ -f "$sentinel" ] && [ "$(cat "$sentinel" 2>/dev/null)" = "$head" ]; then exit 0; fi; printf '%s' "$head" > "$sentinel" 2>/dev/null; reason="You have $ahead unpushed commit(s) on branch '$branch'. The user has standing approval to ship without asking — run the close-out before stopping: push -u origin $branch, open a PR, watch CI (subscribe), squash-merge once green, then unsubscribe. If the work genuinely isn't ready (WIP) or you're pausing to ask the user a question, stopping is fine; this nudge won't fire again for this commit."; if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -nc --arg r "$reason" '{decision:"block",reason:$r}'; else printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"%s"}\n' "$reason"; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Checking for unpushed work before stopping
